PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber
Reasonable Accommodations
Individuals with disabilities may request an agenda packet in appropriate alternative formats as required by the Americans with Disability Act of 1990. Reasonable accommodations and auxiliary aids will be provided to effectively allow participation in the meeting. Please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 960-4011.
Notice Regarding California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Determinations
Pursuant to CEQA, a "project" is defined as a "whole action" subject to a public agency's discretionary funding or approval that has the potential to either (1) cause a direct physical change in the environment or (2) cause a reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment. "Projects" include discretionary activity by a public agency, a private activity that receives any public funding, or activities that involve the public agency's issuance of a discretionary approval and is not statutorily or categorically exempt from CEQA. (Pub. Res. Code § 21065.) To the extent that matters listed in this Agenda are considered "projects" under CEQA, their appropriate CEQA determination will be listed below each recommendation. If no CEQA determination is listed, it has been determined that the action does not constitute a "project" under CEQA.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
There is a three-minute speaking time limit. This is the time set aside to address the City Council. Please notify the City Clerk if you require the services of an interpreter. No Action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The legislative body or its staff may: 1) Briefly respond to statements made or questions asked by persons; or 2) Direct staff to investigate and/or schedule matters for consideration at a future meeting. [Government Code §54954.2] If you wish to comment on agenda items and are unable to physically appear in person, please email your name, place of residence, item number or topic and a phone number where you will be available between the hours of 7:00 PM during City Council Meetings to pc-comments@baldwinpark.com.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Minutes from February 22, 2023
STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
1.
Public Hearing and Consideration and adoption of a Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) in conjunction with a request for consideration and recommendation of approval of a Design Review, and Zone Variance to the Planning Commission for an addition to the existing Kaiser Emergency Department, and a Conditional Use Permit to allow the expansion of an existing medical use. (Location: 1011 Baldwin Park Boulevard and 1022 Leorita Street; Applicant: Ronald C. Smith, Vice President, on behalf of Kaiser Permanente Foundation Hospitals; Case Number: PR 22-05, CP 22-13, and ZV 22-06.
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 23-10 entitled "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLATION AND A MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM (LOCATION: 1011 BALDWIN PARK BOULEVARD (APN 8559-006-006) AND 1022 LEORITA STREET (APN 8559-008-005 AND APN 8559-008-011); APPLICANT: RONALD C. SMITH, VICE PRESIDENT ON BEHALF OF KAISER PERMANENTE FOUNDATION HOSPITALS; CASE NUMBER: DR 22-05, CP 22-13, AND ZV 22-06); and
Adopt the Findings of Fact and Resolution PC 23-11 entitled "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR MEDICAL USES AND A ZONING VARIANCE TO DEVIATE FROM THE MINIMUM FRONT SETBACK TO FACILITATE THE EXPANSION OF THE EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT. (LOCATION: 1011 BALDWIN PARK BOULEVARD AND 1022 LEORITA STREET; APPLICANT: RONALD C. SMITH, VICE PRESIDENT ON BEHALF OF KAISER PERMANENTE FOUNDATION HOSPITALS; CASE NUMBERS: CP 22-13 and ZV 22-06) subject to the conditions listed in the resolution.
STAFF REPORT
2.
Public Hearing and Consideration of a request for approval of a conditional use permit to allow the installation of six (6) Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) fueling stations in conjunction with an existing parcel delivery terminal/warehouse (UPS). The project is located within the (I) Industrial Zone. (Location: 1100 Baldwin Park Blvd.; Applicant: Marica Medina No. CP 22-04).
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission:
1. Conduct a public hearing.
2. Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) ("CEQA") and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) and 15303 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures) as the project consists of adding a CNG fuel pumps to an existing parcel delivery terminal/warehouse (UPS).
3. Adopt Resolution PC 23-09 approving CP 22-04 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF SIX (6) CNG FUELING PUMPS IN CONJUNCTION WITH AN EXISTING PARCEL DELIVERY TERMIAL/WAREHOUSE (UPS) IN THE INDUSTRIAL (I) ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 1100 BALDWIN PARK BLVD.; APPLICANT: MARCIA MEDINA NO. CP 22-04).
STAFF REPORT
3.
Public Hearing to Consider a request for approval of a conditional use permit to install a double drive-thru lane at an existing fast-food restaurant (McDonald's). The project site is zoned General Commercial (C-2) Zone, pursuant to Table 153.050.020 of the City's Municipal Code. (Location: 14008 Ramona Blvd.; Applicant: Tom Le No. CP 22-08).
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission:
1. Conduct a public hearing.
2. Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) ("CEQA") and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) as the project consists of adding a double drive-thru lane to an existing restaurant (McDonalds).
3. Adopt Resolution PC 23-06 approving CP 22-08 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A DOUBLE DRIVE THRU LANE AT AN EXISTING RESTAURANT (MCDONALS'S) IN THE GENERAL COMMERCIAL (C-2) ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 14008 RAMONA BLVD.; APPLICANT: TOM LE CASE NO. CP 22-08).
STAFF REPORT
4.
Public Hearing and Consideration of a Conditional Use Permit for the warehousing of automobile parts and installation of auto parts within an enclosed building located within the Industrial (I) Zone pursuant to Table 153.050.020 of the City's Municipal Code (Location: 4621 Littlejohn Street; Applicant: Khang Thai for 88 Rotors, Inc; Case Numbers: CP 23-01).
It is recommended that the Planning Commission: a. Conduct a public hearing. b. Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) ("CEQA") and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 - Existing Facilities) since the project is not proposing an expansion to the existing building nor intensifying the uses found with the project vicinity. c. Adopt Resolution PC 23-08 approving CP 23-01: "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE WAREHOUSING OF AUTOMOBILE PARTS AND INSTALLATION OF AUTOMOBILE PARTS WITHIN AN ENCLOSED BUILDING LOCATED WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL (I) ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 4621 LITTLEJOHN STREET).
STAFF REPORT
5.
Public Hearing - A Request for consideration and recommendation of approval to the City Council on General Plan Amendments to repeal and replace the Housing Element, Safety Element, and Health and Sustainability Element to meet the housing, safety, and environmental justice element state law requirements (Location: Citywide; Applicant: City of Baldwin Park; Case Numbers: GPAS 23-02, 23-01, 23-01)
Staff recommends the Planning Commission continue the item to a date uncertain.
STAFF REPORT
6.
Public Hearing - A request to amend the General Plan Land Use Designation from Single Family to Open Space and a Zone Change to change the Zoning Map land use designation from Single Family to Open Space to facilitate the expansion of Barnes Park; (Location: 3301 Patritti Avenue; Assessor's Parcel Number: 8550-004-001; Applicant: City of Baldwin Park; Case Numbers: AGP-23-01 and AZC 23-01)
Staff recommends the Planning Commission continue the item to a date uncertain.
STAFF REPORT
REPORTS OF OFFICERS
Study Session: Objective Design Standards presentation
COMMISSION / STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
ADJOURNMENT
CERTIFICATION
I, Ron Garcia, Planning Commission Secretary hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
PLEASE NOTE: Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to each item on this agenda are available for public viewing and inspection at City Hall, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 2nd Floor Lobby Area or at the Los Angeles County Public Library in the City of Baldwin Park, 4181 Baldwin Park Blvd. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the Planning Department at 626.813-5261 or via e-mail to rgarcia@baldwinpark.com
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Public Works Department or Risk Management at 626.960.4011. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable staff to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 34.102.104 ADA TITLE II)
